meta.title: Free AI visibility check for SMEs | Renee
meta.description: How visible is your company in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google? We test 10 customer questions and send you a short report.

h1: How visible is your company in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google?
lead: More and more people ask AI assistants about local providers. We check whether and how your company is mentioned there.

items.t: An answer, not a list of results
items.d: An AI assistant often names only a few providers. If you're missing, you're not compared.

items.t: AI cites what is clearly stated
items.d: Services, location, prices and reviews need to be public and unambiguous.
The same questions, asked regularly, show whether your measures are working.

steps.d: Typical questions from your industry and region.
Where you appear, where you don't and who is named instead.
Three measures you can implement right away.

form.title: Request the check.
form.text: You will receive the report by email within {{stat.report}} hours. The check is free and without obligation.
